name: GrandGalemon
main_effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 Digimon. If this effect suspends your Digimon, you may play 1 Digimon card with the [Bird] or [Avian] in any of its traits with 3000 DP or less from your hand without paying the cost.
source_effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon attacks your opponent's Digimon, you may unsuspend this Digimon.
